slot.brief: Use differentials to approximate the value of √(near a perfect square) or a similar function at a nearby point.

stem: Using differentials, the approximate value of $\sqrt{25.4}$ is
working:
$f(x)=\sqrt{x},\quad f'(x)=\dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}$\\
At $x=25$, $f(25)=5$ and $f'(25)=\dfrac{1}{10}$.\\
$\sqrt{25.4}\approx 5+\dfrac{1}{10}(0.4)=5.04$

Independent check: For f(x)=√x, linearize at x=25: √25.4 ≈ 5 + 0.4/(2·5) = 5.04.
